[Thinking]
**Determining the US President during UN Formation**

The user asked who was President of the United States when the United Nations was formed, and I see that's an interesting question! The UN officially formed on October 24, 1945, after its Charter was ratified. Franklin D. Roosevelt was president until his death on April 12, 1945, after which Harry S. Truman took over. So, I think I'll conclude that the best answer is Harry S. Truman since he was president when it officially formed. I'll make sure to respond in Finnish!
[/Thinking]

Yhdysvaltain presidenttinä oli Harry S. Truman, kun Yhdistyneet Kansakunnat virallisesti muodostettiin (peruskirja astui voimaan 24. lokakuuta 1945). Frank­lin D. Roosevelt oli kuitenkin presidenttinä suunnitteluvaiheissa ja kuoli 12. huhtikuuta 1945.
